intro: Government, civil society, journalism, legal, and media sectors were affected by spyware across the European union, Global, Poland, United states, and Azerbaijan between 2026-04-23 and 2026-10-15. Seven articles cover these incidents. CHOSEN BRICK, Commercial Surveillance Vendors, and CrystalX are the top threat actors named in this coverage. The severity mix includes three high and one medium. This tag archive collects reporting on spyware activity affecting these sectors and regions.
